title: Rebuild the static dashboard and deterministic site assembly
objective: Build an accessible, responsive schema-v2 dashboard and deterministic static-site assembly/smoke tooling that truthfully exposes source modes, freshness, degraded states, methodology, and sparse history on GitHub Pages.
forbidden_changes: Do not change schema v2, Python code, scoring behavior, data source policy, workflows, dependencies, README/docs, or orchestration control files.
Do not use CDN-hosted runtime assets, absolute /mom-index paths, external analytics, cookies, or inline fabricated readings.
Do not hide unavailable, simulated, stale, error, loading, empty, or insufficient-history states.
Do not modify or merge into the default branch.
deliverables: frontend/index.html with semantic Chinese UI and noscript fallback
Split responsive CSS and JavaScript assets plus vendored Chart.js 4.x runtime and license notice
Schema-v2 rendering for four indices, buy/sell metrics, history, top posts, source badges, generated/last-success time, warnings, and plain-language methodology
Client-side staleness recomputation and graceful loading/error/empty/insufficient-history/chart-failure states
Mobile layout verified at 375 CSS pixels and accessible keyboard/focus/color behavior
scripts/build_site.py assembling a clean _site artifact with relative paths and one copied public payload
scripts/check_site.py validating payload/schema, asset references, no CDN dependency, truthful labels, and secret-like content
Removal of tracked frontend/data duplicates from source and atomic implementation commit plus handoff report
acceptance_criteria: The built artifact contains index.html, all locally referenced assets, and data/dashboard_data.json with only relative subpath-safe references.
The dashboard renders a useful shell and source/freshness state even when Chart.js fails; empty payloads do not display invented charts or readings.
Unavailable and simulated sources are visibly distinct, and stale state is recalculated in the browser from last_success_at.
The page no longer claims Douyin or any source absent from the payload and never describes Xiaohongshu as live when unavailable.
No loading spinner remains after success/error, no grid overflows at 375px, and links to source posts are safe external links.
Site build and smoke commands pass and changes remain inside declared write scope.
